summary: Iteration 7 — tested the rentals editable-bill / carry-forward / payment-mode+reference feature set end to end. Backend: new pytest suite (19 cases) covering bill edit+persist, carry-forward (dues + advance credit) via API, reference enforcement on collections & payouts, and regression on statement/export/receipt/auth. Frontend: Playwright flows on Bills (carry stat, editable inputs, live total, save+persist, WhatsApp message content), Collections (mode list, required reference, blocked submit, mode+reference columns, cash path, receipt PDF) and Payouts (mode list, reference required for non-cash non-credit, credit path, table columns), plus regression on Rent Roll / Reports / maintenance workspace. 18/19 backend cases pass; all frontend flows pass. Also fixed 8 stale iteration-6 tests that broke because of the new reference rule, and made the CORS test proxy-aware. Full suite now 116 passed / 1 failed.

minor.issue: require_reference() is NOT called on update: a payment can be edited to mode=upi/bank with an empty reference and returns 200. Same gap in PUT /api/rentals/payouts/{pid}. POST correctly returns 400.

Carry-forward only reads the immediately previous month AND only if that month's bill was actually saved. If month M's bill was never saved (draft) but the tenant paid nothing, month M+1 draft shows carry_forward = 0, so genuinely unpaid dues silently disappear and dues older than one month never accumulate.
prev_outstanding() runs 2 extra queries per unit (N+1) inside the bills/statement loop; fine at current scale, will degrade with many properties.

integration_issues.issue: After a successful submit the form resets mode back to the default 'upi' (blank state) even if the user had selected Cash, so the next entry silently switches to UPI and re-shows the required reference field. Payouts preserves the chosen mode; behaviour is inconsistent.
Category defaults to 'Common electricity' (cats[0]) instead of Maintenance even though a 'Maintenance' category exists; the preference effect appears to run against a stale/unsorted list.

issues: Non-cash submit without a reference is blocked only by the native HTML5 'Please fill out this field' bubble — no in-app error text/toast, so the backend 400 message ('A reference number is required') is never surfaced. Acceptable but a styled inline error would match the rest of the app.
WhatsApp / SMS buttons disappear while the card is in edit mode (only rendered in the read state) — user must save/cancel before sending; minor discoverability nit.

action_items: Call require_reference() in PUT /api/rentals/payments/{pid} and PUT /api/rentals/payouts/{pid} (currently only POST enforces it).

Decide/fix carry-forward for unsaved previous months: either auto-derive the previous month's billable total from the unit master when no bill doc exists, or accumulate the whole unpaid history instead of just M-1.
Collections: keep the user's selected payment mode after a successful submit (match Payouts behaviour).
Payouts: make the default category resolve to 'Maintenance' when present.
Optional: surface the backend 400 reference error as an inline/toast message instead of relying on the native HTML5 validation bubble.
critical_code_review_comments: rentals.py is 745 lines (>700 guideline) — split bills/payments/payouts/statement/export into modules.

Carry-forward is snapshotted into the saved bill and never recomputed; if a payment for month M is recorded/deleted after month M+1's bill was saved, M+1's carry becomes stale. Intentional (editable) but should be documented in the UI copy.
Deposits still post a hard-coded mode 'bank' with no mode/reference input, inconsistent with the new Cash/UPI/Bank + reference policy applied to collections and payouts.
prev_outstanding() re-queries per unit inside list_bills/build_statement — batch the previous-month bills and payments in one query.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (Bills, Collections, Payouts, regression)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified working: bill-stat-carry, bill-edit/bill-rent-input/bill-maintenance-input/bill-payable-input/bill-carry-input, bill-live-total, bill-save persistence, WhatsApp message (contains Rent, Maintenance and 'Previous dues' lines, wa.me/91... link), Collections mode dropdown = exactly [Cash, UPI, Bank Transfer], required collection-reference-input (blocks submit), Mode+Reference columns (payment-reference-<id>), cash-without-reference success, receipt PDF download, Payouts mode/reference + credit path, and carry-forward API math (6000 dues, -2000 advance). Note the app has a /mode chooser after login (data-testid mode-rentals-btn) and rentMonth resets to the current month on any full page load — set the month via [data-testid=rent-month-switcher] AFTER navigating with in-app links. Only known open failure: TestCollectionReference::test_update_payment_enforces_reference (PUT payments/payouts skip require_reference). Auth playbook checks re-verified: bcrypt $2b$ hashes, httpOnly cookies, lockout after 5 fails, seed_admin updates existing admin, CORS_ORIGINS explicit (app returns explicit origin on 8001; the preview edge proxy rewrites it to '*', so backend_test's CORS test now skips in that case).
rca_of_the_issue: Reference enforcement lives in require_reference() which is invoked only from create_payment() and create_payout(); the update handlers (update_payment/update_payout) validate the month and unit but never the mode/reference pair, so an existing cash entry can be flipped to UPI/bank with a blank reference. Carry-forward gap: prev_outstanding() returns 0.0 early when db.rental_bills has no document for month M-1, so an unbilled-but-unpaid month contributes nothing to the next month's draft.
